test_title: PYST 9: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

And his ________ manner should not be mistaken for a lack of energy.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2' **i.e.** 'Diffident'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is:** 'Diffident'.**
 
• **Explanation:** The adjective **"diffident" **describes someone who is shy or lacking in self-confidence.
 
• Therefore, the sentence is saying that his shy manner should not be mistaken for a lack of energy.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'And his** diffident **manner should not be mistaken for a lack of energy.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Deem - **consider or judge in a specified way. It is a verb and hence doesn't fit the sentence which requires an adjective.
 
• **Daunt - **make (someone) feel intimidated or apprehensive. This is also a verb and hence doesn't fit the sentence structure.
 
• **Debase -** reduce (something) in quality or value; degrade. This is a verb and doesn't fit grammatically in the sentence.
